engineering_ready.evidence: make research-check ARGS="--strict" → complete=True (p5a,p5b,p6a,p6b,p7 all PASS); docs/execution/evidence/research/checks/results.json
engineering_ready.note: the local pipeline builds, validates cases offline, runs the dual-model studies and reports; engineering readiness is not a claim that any research hypothesis is supported

experiment_execution_complete.note: the dual-model batches (6B 24 units + the held-out 8) were requested, answered and scored with complete denominators; a model answering wrongly would still be a complete experiment

supported: the model-with-program-dependency method generalises beyond the first sample: the new held-out token-bucket case (a different mechanism) validates and both models judged it correctly (program-grounded)
across 6B (24) and the held-out (8) units both models were correct on every unit at this difficulty; no representation sensitivity was observed on the harmless synthetic framings
not_supported: any statistical ranking or superiority claim (tiny samples, clustered by case)
a verified provider comparison (both models answered through a relay; identity is relay-reported, K08/K15)
general attack-modelling capability, or any conclusion about the disguised-attack / regulation-evasion experiment (not run)
findings_supported.note: these tasks are easy enough that both models scored 100% (K13); the finding is that the method and the independent checks work on a second mechanism, not that one model is better

independent_human_reproduction.note: no person has independently reproduced it yet; when one does, record the reproducer, date and any differences — an agent re-running in a clean directory is only automated reproduction

uncovered: the original adviser scope included hiding a real attack purpose to test regulation evasion; that experiment was not run and these materials do not support that conclusion
original_adviser_scope_complete.note: only the adviser can accept an adjusted research scope; an agent cannot do so on their behalf. This stays false until the adviser accepts the adjusted scope and its acceptance is complete

local_total_acceptance.note: phases 1-4 strict acceptance was complete=true at their revisions (a05c1d2 / b993dc9); the phase-7 domain changes (K01/K02) are covered by p7-unit and the d2 broker evidence re-run. A full re-run needs the dev stack (scripts/dev.sh up) and ≥15 GiB free disk (currently less); it is the documented baseline command, run by the user when that headroom is available

reproduction.offline_artifact_reference: scripts/offline_bundle.py manifest now carries a research_data reference (cases/studies/results/rubric digests + source revision)
